US Senator Rubio meets Indian FM Jaishankar in Mumbai

US Senator Marco Rubio met Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar in Mumbai. During the meeting, Rubio advocated for an early trade deal between India and the United States. The two officials also reviewed the strategic roadmap between the two nations.
